name: What preparation is needed before crown molding installation begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before crown molding installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the carpentry team arrives, clear furniture away from the perimeter walls so ladders and cutting stations can be set up safely. Remove fragile wall hangings, drapery, and electronics from the room. Identify whether your home has existing drywall cracks, water staining, or past settling along the ceiling line, as these can be repaired alongside the installation. It is also helpful to have your intended trim paint sheen and color selected so prep and finish coats can proceed without interruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture away from room perimeters, remove wall decor, and identify any ceiling drywall damage beforehand so repairs can be coordinated with the trim work.
